turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
I have 140 students. I don't have time to be cross-examined by every parent with a law degree.
140 students. I'm here about one of them. What do you actually have on his essay?
You don't get to talk to me like I'm on the stand.
Nobody's on the stand. My son has a zero, and I asked on what basis.
